capabilities: Break tables out of readable line width
extras: Desktop only; breakout behavior has not been verified on mobile.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that makes wide tables pleasant to read — without touching your readable line width.
problem: Wide tables often become unreadable due to excessive wrapping or lack of proper scrolling mechanisms within the standard Obsidian view.
summary: A plugin that customizes table styles in Obsidian, allowing for minimum column widths, horizontal scrolling, and alignment adjustments to improve readability.
